alt: JPMorgan Dropped Polymarket Banking Over Regulatory Risk

items.h: Crypto payments barely register among euro area merchants, ECB finds
items.s: Crypto acceptance was just 0.2% online and remained below 1% at physical points of sale, while mobile payments gained ground.
